name: Toramaru Iori
source:
Hibiki Ryouta's best friend from the same high school. He used to be active in the baseball club together with Ryouta and was a star player as the ace. In university, he continues to excel as both a pitcher and a batter.

He is a well-rounded sportsman who is also good at studying. He never fails to do training such as weight lifting, and is sometimes talked about as a promising player for the future.

[From [url=https://skskdan.com/gachi-haru/en]SKSKDan[/url]]
